title: Spacious 2BR Home in Rosemary Beach with Beach Access
meta_description: Stay in this spacious 2BR, 2BA Rosemary Beach home, with a sleeper sofa, a full kitchen, private beach and pool access, and high-speed WiFi. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded: DescriptionThe Southern Serenity Carriage House was designed by the famous local design firm Tracery Interiors. Sleeping the largest amount of guests of any carriage house in our program, Southern Serenity’s Sister provides a stylish, convenient and economical option for multiple guests.The main level features a private master bedroom with Queen bed, private bath & flat screen TV. The gathering room has vaulted ceilings, flat screen TV with surround sound as well as a pull out Queen sleeper sofa, dining table for up to four guests and kitchen with full size appliances. A spiral staircase leads you to a closed loft with two Queen beds, full bath and TV - perfect for singles, couples, or children.Whether you start a game of bocce on the nearby West Long Green, enjoy the sunshine or stars from your private balcony, or take a stroll to the nearby boutiques, restaurants and pools, Southern Serenity’s Sister is quite an appealing affordable option right here in Rosemary Beach.HOME HIGHLIGHTS:• Bedding: 3 Queen Beds | 1 Sleeper Sofa• Clean Bedding Program• 2 Complimentary Bicycles Included • Can also be rented with adjacent 3 bedroom + loft Southern Serenity Cottage (VRBO 969004)• Fully-equipped kitchen• High Speed Wifi Internet Access• Large Balcony • Street Parking Only• Washer / Dryer in Garage• 3-4 Minute walk to beach walkover I or H• 30 Second walk to the Cabana Pool• 1 Minute walk to Barbados Pool
